tasks.description: Assembles Markdown chapters into a single page in the order of the book summary. Use when asked to assemble or combine a book's chapters into one document.
tasks.intent: Assemble book chapters into a single Markdown page.

tasks.description: Checks a book's summary file against the chapter files and first headings. Use when asked to check a book's table of contents.
tasks.intent: Check the book table of contents against chapter files.

tasks.description: Finds links between book chapters that point to missing files or headings. Use when asked for a broken cross-reference report on a book.
tasks.intent: Report broken cross-references between book chapters.
